conf.description: OpenShift OAuth server/API audit, syslog-raw (RFC5424): same un-frame as the API-server audit; MSG is the OAuth audit.k8s.io/v1 Event, nested under kubernetes.audit. Query-string token redaction is a source-side ClusterLogForwarder concern per the catalog and is not implemented here (see README gap).

conf.comment: OpenShift OAuth audit via ClusterLogForwarder syslog output. Un-frame RFC5424, parse MSG as the OAuth audit Event, nest under kubernetes.audit. Catalog requires token-bearing query-string redaction to happen upstream at the ClusterLogForwarder before framing - not a Cribl step, recorded as a gap.

functions.description: record dataset, format, and parsing approach
strip the RFC5424 frame: PRI, TIMESTAMP, HOSTNAME, APP-NAME, PROCID, MSGID, MSG
batch the mapped header fields to their ECS targets
decompose PRI into facility/severity, nest the audit Event, promote log_source, set _time from the event's own timestamp, tag event.dataset
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
